name: faangin-backend
description: Faangin accounts, billing, licensing and Pro gateway on Firebase

scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix gateway run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix gateway run typecheck
scripts.test: bash scripts/check-secrets.sh && npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix gateway test && npm run test:client
scripts.stripe:smoke: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/stripe-sandbox-smoke.mjs --sandbox
